title: Rav Shimi bar Ukva
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Berakhot 10a describes him as frequently sitting before Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi, who would arrange aggadic teachings before Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi. This last clause refers to Shimon ben Pazi, not Shimi bar Ukva, as cited in Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: Hyman expressly assigns the arrangement of aggadic teachings to Shimon ben Pazi, not Shimi bar Ukva. The English follows that correction consistently.

The consulted Berakhot paragraph also gives Mar Ukva as an alternative name and leaves the subject of the arranging clause implicit. Hyman assigns the clause to Shimon ben Pazi, citing Dikdukei Soferim.
